name: Karnataka Rajyotsava Disability Scholarship
description: State scholarship for students with disabilities pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses in Karnataka.
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement up to ₹15,000 per year
deadline_note: Applications typically open in June–July each academic year. Check the portal for current dates.
notes: Applicant must be a resident of Karnataka. Disability certificate must be issued by a government-recognised medical authority.
